items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I have a trio record of his called “To You With Love” that was purchased at the Tate Street Drug Store in 1963 for a dollar.

ctx.x: Zawinul, excuse me, Zawinul. I have a trio record of his called “To You With Love” that was purchased at the Tate Street Drug Store in 1963 for a dollar. It’s on a label called Strand. And Louis Porter, who has everything ever — you know Louis?
Um hum. I don’t know him but I know who he is.
